# Samsung Cloud Solution
> Samsung Cloud Solution provides cloud-based enterprise services, device management, and business technology solutions from Samsung.

This site appears to focus on Samsung enterprise cloud offerings, business services, solution overviews, support resources, and contact pathways for organizations evaluating Samsung cloud and managed solutions.

## Main
- [Home](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/): Main entry point for Samsung Cloud Solution offerings and business services.
- [About](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/about): Overview of the company, mission, and enterprise solution focus.
- [Contact](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/contact): Contact page for sales inquiries, partnership requests, and general support.
- [Support](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/support): Central support area for customer assistance and service information.

## Solutions
- [Solutions](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/solutions): Overview of available cloud, enterprise, and managed solution categories.
- [Cloud Services](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/solutions/cloud-services): Information about hosted cloud infrastructure and business service capabilities.
- [Managed Services](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/solutions/managed-services): Details on managed operations, monitoring, and enterprise service support.
- [Enterprise Mobility](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/solutions/enterprise-mobility): Coverage of mobility-focused business solutions and device-centered workflows.
- [Security Solutions](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/solutions/security): Overview of security-oriented services for enterprise environments.

## Products
- [Products](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/products): Catalog of productized offerings available through Samsung Cloud Solution.
- [Device Management](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/products/device-management): Product information for managing enterprise devices and deployment policies.
- [Cloud Platform](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/products/cloud-platform): Details on the platform used to deliver cloud-based business services.
- [Collaboration Tools](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/products/collaboration-tools): Information on tools supporting communication and team productivity.
- [Analytics](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/products/analytics): Product area covering reporting, insights, and operational analytics.

## Industries
- [Industries](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/industries): Overview of industry-specific solution positioning and use cases.
- [Healthcare](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/industries/healthcare): Solutions tailored for healthcare organizations and regulated operational needs.
- [Retail](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/industries/retail): Retail-focused services for customer engagement and store operations.
- [Education](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/industries/education): Education-oriented cloud and device solutions for institutions.
- [Finance](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/industries/finance): Enterprise solutions for financial services and secure business workflows.

## Resources
- [Resources](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/resources): Central library of informational materials, downloads, and supporting content.

- [White Papers](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/resources/white-papers): In-depth documents covering architecture, strategy, and solution benefits.
- [Datasheets](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/resources/datasheets): Downloadable product summaries and technical capability overviews.
- [FAQs](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/resources/faq): Frequently asked questions about services, onboarding, and support.

- [Administrator Guide](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/docs/admin-guide): Administrative instructions for managing services and enterprise settings.

- [Release Notes](https://samsungcloudsolution.com/docs/release-notes): Updates describing changes, improvements, and newly available functionality.

## Developers
